integrity: All displayed numerical coefficients follow from an exact rank-one analytic perturbation and explicitly stated centered moments. Numerical quadrature is supplementary, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic for each fixed bounded measurable set as the band width decreases; no global-in-bandwidth or higher-eigenvalue statement. Potential historical priority overlap with older unindexed prolate expansions is unresolved.
title: A seventh-order moment law for narrow-band Fourier concentration on bounded sets
